proof.text: Use the basis and image descriptions in lem-sc-invertible-module-generic-stalk. If g times the generic image of a stalk generator lies in the stalk image, comparison of coefficients in that basis expresses g as a nonzero local scalar. The valuation nonnegativity characterization in lem-sc-smooth-connected-curve-local-rings therefore gives nonnegative order. Given the two coefficient expressions for s, division shows that (g/g') lam(e) = lam(e') and conversely. The two nonnegative valuation differences force equality of orders. This is the private proved helper coefficient_order_nonneg followed by the local proof hind.

proof.text: Represent s by a section z on an open V containing the generic point, using the stalk germ representation. Local triviality gives a free generator e on a smaller affine neighbourhood W. Write the restriction of z as a e by its uniquely determined coefficient. Taking generic germs shows that the germ of a is nonzero, since s is nonzero. The basic open D(a) therefore contains the generic point. At each P in D(a), the germ of a is a unit. The germ of e spans the stalk: represent any stalk element on a smaller neighbourhood, express that representative in the free generator, and take germs (private proved helper span_germ_of_freeGenerator). Hence the germ of z is also a generator, and specialization of this germ equals s.

proof.text: At each closed P in D(a), compare an arbitrary generator and coefficient g with the generator given by the germ of z and coefficient 1. The already proved independence makes the order of g zero. Thus all points in the nonzero-order support lie outside D(a). Apply the already proved source-library theorem IsOpen.finite_compl_of_topologicalKrullDim_le_one, recorded as lem-sc-nonempty-open-complement-finite-dim-le-one. Its Noetherianity and irreducibility hypotheses follow from lem-sc-smooth-connected-curve-local-rings, and its dimension bound follows from def-sc-curves. A subset of that finite complement is finite.

lean.statement: theorem rational_section_order (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (C : Scheme.{u}) (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsConnectedCurve f] [Smooth f] (L : C.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] : let hC := Classical.choose (C.smooth_connected_curve_local_rings k f) letI := hC let h := Classical.choose_spec (C.smooth_connected_curve_local_rings k f) let η := genericPoint C let lam := fun x : C ↦ TopCat.Presheaf.stalkSpecializes L.val.presheaf ((genericPoint_spec C).specializes (Set.mem_univ x)) let v := fun P : {P : C // P ∈ closedPoints C} ↦ Classical.choose ((h.2.2.2.2.2.2.2.2 P.val P.property).2.2) ∀ (s : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf η)), s ≠ 0 → (∀ (P : {P : C // P ∈ closedPoints C}) (e e' : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf P.val)), Submodule.span (C.presheaf.stalk P.val) {e} = ⊤ → Submodule.span (C.presheaf.stalk P.val) {e'} = ⊤ → ∀ g g' : C.functionFieldˣ, s = (g : C.functionField) • lam P.val e → s = (g' : C.functionField) • lam P.val e' → Multiplicative.toAdd (v P g) = Multiplicative.toAdd (v P g')) ∧ Set.Finite {P : C | ∃ hP : P ∈ closedPoints C, ∃ e : ↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk L.val.presheaf P), Submodule.span (C.presheaf.stalk P) {e} = ⊤ ∧ ∃ g : C.functionFieldˣ, s = (g : C.functionField) • lam P e ∧ Multiplicative.toAdd (v ⟨P, hP⟩ g) ≠ 0}
